title: senna rostrata
intro: Senna rostrata, commonly known as the thread-pod senna or thread-pod cassia, is a plant species in the legume family that is native to tropical Africa. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits including the treatment of constipation, diarrhea, and other gastrointestinal issues due to its purgative properties. The therapeutic actions of Senna rostrata are attributed to its ability to stimulate bowel movements and relieve symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthraquinones, such as aloe-emodin, chrysophanol, and emodin, which are responsible for its laxative and anti-inflammatory effects.
